source: User-supplied KAN-109_API_연결_계약.md; migration 20261103080639_web_supplier_ac_registration reported applied by DB owner, not independently inspected.

http.authentication: Same Supabase JWT dependency as mailbox connect; owner is the verified principal, never request data.

query.expected_revision: Optional positive integer; if omitted read current owned work_cases.input_revision. RPC rechecks the exact revision.

data.items: C candidate objects from the documented RPC array, validated before exposure

http.frontend_contract: This path/envelope is the backend implementation proposal based on the supplied review path. Frontend wiring and deployment still require joint verification.

rpc.name: list_web_contact_candidates
rpc.return: Raw array, [] when empty. No wrapper, license_no or observed_at is invented. service_role server client only.

c_policy.identity: candidate_id is separate from supplier_id; supplier_id/contact_email must be null.
c_policy.storage: No direct reads/writes to web_contact_candidates; deployed RPC owns revision and promoted-A exclusion. No phone workflow added.

rfq.selection: Fresh API-12 requests require an existing owned REGISTERED/VERIFIED_WEB supplier with matching current business email plus actual owned supplier_items referenced by the saved candidate. Guard precedes policy lookup and mutation; durable replay skips fresh checks.
rfq.registered_mapping: LINKED_REGISTERED alone and empty supplier_item_ids do not qualify. Agent catalog tools already read supplier_items with owner filter; candidate snapshots require item evidence. Missing or wrong-supplier mappings block selection.
rfq.approval: No domain-specific approval and no web_supplier_rfq_approval_required call. Existing settings, mailbox scope limits, caution semantics and user selection gate are preserved.
rfq.concurrency: DB selection transaction, send claim and RFQ contact trigger must enforce authoritative mutable facts; Python read checks are not a transaction or sending authorization.

error_mapping.unknown_SQLSTATE_or_invalid_RPC_shape: 503 PROCESSING_UNAVAILABLE; provider messages/details/hints are not returned or logged

scope.registration: upsert_web_supplier five-argument registration and crawl-to-registration mapping remain the collector owner responsibility; full registration JSON contract was not supplied here. No registration HTTP endpoint invented.
scope.B_status_branch: Separate; no B rollout changes in this branch.

verification.openapi: contact-candidates route/query/schema checked in isolated FastAPI app
verification.http_network_transport: Not exercised; route function and serialization tested directly.
verification.selection_flow: Passed: guard before policy/write, existing approval settings, immutable replay
verification.additional_review: Contact trigger rejection remains 409 without draft recovery lookup; lost-ack recovery and immutable snapshot checks retained; contact service reuses app-scoped client.

remaining: Frontend must consume the separate data.items contacts list and retain both false flags.
Verify against actual deployed RPC with owned/no-result/foreign/stale-revision cases after deployment; no live verification claimed.
A promotion, duplicate suppression and REGISTERED no-update behavior are DB/collector responsibilities and need end-to-end verification with the owning teammate.
